config-manager-market.disclaimer.install.text:
You are about to reinstall configs from your public repo to this machine.

This is content you uploaded before, but it still goes through the same validation and content selection (all selected by default):
· High-risk sections are flagged in the selection step; unchecking them excludes them from the import and the snapshot;
· A snapshot is auto-created before import and one-click rollback is available afterwards.
